annotations.description: Block agent writes to security-sensitive network configuration (ACL, firewall, routing policy, RADIUS/AAA).
annotations.message: Blocked: this action would modify a security-sensitive network policy. Autonomous agents can propose the change and log the recommendation, but the commit must be approved by a human (Level 5 in the autonomy hierarchy).
annotations.guidance: Write the recommendation to remediation.log and page the on-call engineer. If this is a genuine emergency, an authorized operator can approve the change in the Conduct console.
